races.paceDynamic: Donna Rumma will dictate terms from the front with her consistent pace-setting style, likely getting an uncontested lead in this small field. The prominent runners Lake Muritz and Silesia will track her but neither has shown aggressive early tendencies. With Love A Giggle and Showmethebubbles held up at the back, there's a clear pace divide that should create a steady tempo throughout. This race shape strongly favours front runners and prominent racers who can position close to Donna Rumma's expected lead.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Donna Rumma dominates
scenarios.trigger: If Donna Rumma gets her favoured soft ground lead without pressure
scenarios.body: She can control the fractions and kick clear in the final furlong, making use of her proven form on similar conditions. Her recent consistency and tactical advantage make her the logical beneficiary.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent trio battle
scenarios.trigger: If Lake Muritz or Silesia press Donna Rumma early and create genuine pace
scenarios.body: The tempo quickens enough to set up a driving finish between the three prominent runners, with class and fitness deciding. Donna Rumma's recent race fitness could prove decisive in a sustained battle.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold up surprise
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes crawling
scenarios.body: Love A Giggle's winning form and stronger finishing kick can overcome positioning disadvantages in a sprint finish. The weight penalty becomes less relevant in a slowly-run race that suits her hold-up style.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Persian Sunset unknown
scenarios.trigger: If Persian Sunset shows unexpected early pace or tactical speed
scenarios.body: The lightly-raced filly with unknown ability could exploit any pace scenario given her high rating and fresh legs. Her trainer's recent strike rate suggests she's been placed to advantage.

races.paceDynamic: Hvar is the sole confirmed front runner and will dictate terms from the gates, likely getting an uncontested lead in this 16-runner handicap over the minimum trip. The prominent racers including Yellow Diamonds, Showtown, Star Noir, and Come On Over will settle just behind but won't pressure early on soft ground that encourages waiting tactics. With a large field and only one natural leader, this sets up as a tactical affair where the pace will be steady early before a cavalry charge in the final two furlongs. This race shape strongly favours hold-up horses and those that can produce a sustained finish, as the early pace will be insufficient to string out this large field.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Dominate
scenarios.trigger: If Hvar gets an easy lead and the pace stays modest through halfway
scenarios.body: The field will bunch up turning for home allowing the strongest finishers to weave through and time their challenge perfectly. Horses like Artista, Explosive Finnish, and Bye Law who need cover and a strong pace to aim at will find ideal conditions.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Racers Strike
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent group applies more pressure than expected and Hvar comes back to them
scenarios.body: Yellow Diamonds and Showtown are well-positioned to capitalize from their handy positions without having done the early donkey work. Their tactical speed and ability to quicken off a steady pace makes them dangerous when others are still getting organized.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hvar Wires The Field
scenarios.trigger: If Hvar gets completely loose on the lead and the soft ground plays to his favor
scenarios.body: The leader builds an unassailable advantage while the pack fails to organize a cohesive challenge on the testing surface. His recent win at Redcar shows he can dominate when getting things his own way from the front.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If nobody wants to race early and it becomes a crawl until the final furlong
scenarios.body: The race becomes a pure sprint finish where the handiest horses with natural gate speed can steal a march on the field. This would suit horses like Believeinmenow who can be prominent early but also has a sharp turn of foot.

watchPoints.text: Hvar getting a soft lead could be decisive as he's the only natural front runner in this large field
Yellow Diamonds looks the main threat to any pace scenario given her soft ground win and tactical speed
The apprentice riders on Black Missile and Houndhill may struggle to get the best positions in a big field
Artista and other hold-up horses need the pace to develop properly or they'll be climbing a mountain
Track the early fractions as any horse getting first run on this tactical setup could steal a decisive advantage

races.paceDynamic: Hedge Fund will take this race up from the front and should get an uncontested lead with most of the field happy to settle behind him. The prominent runners Copper Knight, Master Of My Fate, Canon's House, Emerald Harmony and Hundred Caps will track the leader in a cluster, while hold-up horses Trilby and Ventura Express drop out the back. With only one confirmed front runner, Hedge Fund can dictate a steady gallop before quickening, but the sheer weight of prominent runners tracking him means they'll be perfectly positioned when the pace lifts. This race shape strongly favours the prominent runners who can sit close enough to strike but avoid doing the donkey work that Hedge Fund will be forced into.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Prominent Runners Pounce
scenarios.trigger: If Hedge Fund sets steady fractions and the prominent pack times their move perfectly
scenarios.body: The patient prominent runners get the ideal trip tracking the lone leader before unleashing their finish in the final furlong. Copper Knight's class and Master Of My Fate's recent Southwell win make them perfectly suited to this tactical scenario.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Front Runner Sustains
scenarios.trigger: If Hedge Fund's 198-day break has freshened him up and he can quicken off steady fractions
scenarios.body: The leader gets first run on his rivals and his superior TopSpeed rating of 91 tells as the field struggles to reel him back. His previous course form shows he can handle Beverley's unique demands when fresh.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horses Swoop
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely and becomes a sprint from the 2f pole
scenarios.body: Trilby and Ventura Express get the perfect setup from their patient positions as the early pace-setters tie up. Their hold-up style thrives when the race becomes a raw speed test over the final two furlongs.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Early
scenarios.trigger: If Hedge Fund goes too slow early and gets swamped by the field turning for home
scenarios.body: The race becomes a messy scramble with no clear pace advantage, favouring the most naturally speedy horses regardless of position. This chaotic finish suits horses with raw pace like those showing higher recent RPR figures.

scenarios.body: His soft ground form is solid and the lack of early pressure allows him to dictate throughout before holding off late challengers. The winner's recent success at this trip on similar ground makes him hard to peg back.

scenarios.label: C

scenarios.trigger: If the four prominent runners engage in early tactical warfare behind Sea Master
scenarios.body: The pace becomes unsustainably fast as Freddy Robinson, Assured, El Ghaawy and The Pug refuse to give ground. This sets up perfectly for the strongest closer to sweep past exhausted leaders in the final furlong.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapse Special
scenarios.trigger: If Sea Master stops quickly and the prominent group stalls turning in
scenarios.body: The race becomes a crawl with no genuine pace, turning into a tactical sprint where track position matters most. The handiest horse with the best finishing kick prevails in a bunched finish.

races.paceDynamic: Mandarin Spirit will lead from the gate as the only confirmed front runner, likely setting a sustainable pace over 7½f on this testing ground. The real battle develops behind him with Jungle Ruler, North Force, Suddenly I See, The Resdev Scholar, Lyrical Song, Dunkeld Dreamer, Cool Molly and Night Patrol all wanting prominent positions - creating significant congestion and potential traffic problems turning for home. Only Gorey Gold sits back as a genuine hold-up horse, giving him a clean passage while the prominent pack scraps for racing room 2-3 furlongs out. This race shape strongly favours horses that can either lead cleanly or come from the back, as the prominent runners face tactical nightmares in heavy ground.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Leader Gets Away
scenarios.trigger: If Mandarin Spirit breaks cleanly and the prominent pack allows him easy fractions early
scenarios.body: The front runner exploits the congestion behind by building an unassailable lead while rivals get shuffled back in traffic. His sustainable pace on testing ground becomes the winning weapon.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Strikes Gold
scenarios.trigger: If the prominent congestion creates the expected traffic problems turning for home
scenarios.body: Gorey Gold gets the clearest passage of all while prominent rivals get checked and shuffled, allowing him to pick up the pieces late. Tudhope's tactical riding from the back proves decisive in this messy affair.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Form Horse Overcomes Traffic
scenarios.trigger: If Suddenly I See or Jungle Ruler can secure early position without getting trapped
scenarios.body: The best-handicapped horses use class to overcome the tactical disadvantage, with their recent winning form proving too strong despite poor positioning. Superior ability trumps pace dynamics.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Pace Collapses Completely
scenarios.trigger: If Mandarin Spirit goes too slow early and the prominent pack stays patient
scenarios.body: The race becomes a sprint finish where the freshest horse wins, turning into a messy scramble that suits whoever gets the last clear run. Recent course form becomes crucial.

Keep an eye on Cool Molly's turf debut - her all-weather form suggests she has ability but surface switch is unknown

races.paceDynamic: Evelyn's Phoenix is the only confirmed front-runner and will set the pace without pressure, likely creating a steady tempo through the early stages. Copper And Five, Law Degree, and Penny Ghent will sit prominently behind, but this modest group won't create any significant early pressure. The majority of the field are hold-up horses who will need the pace to collapse in the final 2-3 furlongs. With a solo leader able to dictate comfortable fractions on soft ground over this staying trip, this race strongly favours front-runners and prominent racers who can stay close to the pace and kick when it matters.

scenarios.label: A
scenarios.title: Evelyn's Phoenix Controls
scenarios.trigger: If the solo leader sets modest fractions without early pressure from the prominent group
scenarios.body: Evelyn's Phoenix gets an uncontested lead and kicks clear in the straight while the hold-up brigade leave their runs too late on the testing ground. The prominent racers who stayed in touch have the best chance of reeling in the leader.

scenarios.label: B
scenarios.title: Prominent Pressure Tells
scenarios.trigger: If Copper And Five and Law Degree press forward to challenge the leader from halfway
scenarios.body: The increased tempo softens up Evelyn's Phoenix while still being strong enough to blunt the finishing kicks of the hold-up horses. One of the prominent racers who stayed closest benefits most.

scenarios.label: C
scenarios.title: Hold-Up Horse Swoops
scenarios.trigger: If the pace collapses completely in the final quarter-mile allowing closers time to wind up
scenarios.body: The soft ground and modest early gallop creates the perfect storm for a strong stayer to come from the back and time their run perfectly. Pisanello or Coolree could capitalise.

scenarios.label: D
scenarios.title: Outsider Benefits Chaos
scenarios.trigger: If the favourites fail to fire and the race becomes scrappy with no clear pace narrative
scenarios.body: An unfancied runner who gets the right trip at the right time steals it while the market principals underperform. The race becomes a lottery.
